_说明: 角色卡片示例 —— 沙猎部落·喽啰C·弓箭手 Archer。把本文件复制一份改成新角色即可。
DOC_TITLE: 万物生 第1集 · 沙猎喽啰C · 弓箭手 默认形态四视图人设图 v1
FORMAT_INHERIT: 完全同头领/女副手/喽啰A/B格式：9:16竖版+4格不等大+正脸特写/侧脸特写/脖子以下/背面+single-side rim backlight。
ROLE_POSITION: 沙猎部落普通喽啰之一——**弓箭手 Archer**。功能：远程支援+追踪+战术情报。配合A钩索手锁定+B沙艇驾驶手围困。3个喽啰中最年长最老练。
QA_NOTES:
1. 族群准确——Central Asian/Turkic/Sogdian，欧美白人脸或纯汉人脸都失败
2. 9:16+4格不等大+最高分辨率
3. 左下panel不能露脸
4. lean tall修长体型——不是bulky也不是slender frail
5. 长辫+长须——和A的短发短stubble、B的女性高马尾形成清楚区分
6. 左前臂vambrace机械瞄准器 + 右手指尖金属甲套——正面身体格可见
7. 背挂长复合弓——背面格可见
8. 不是fantasy elf archer（容易跑歪）+不是日式弓道家
9. 战利品sparse but refined——和A的pure utilitarian sparse、B的slightly more形成微差
GAZE_DESC: calm focused veteran archer's gaze toward camera
HEADWEAR_REST_STATE: Tribal headwrap is currently pulled down loose around the neck revealing his face fully (in field operations the headwrap covers his nose/mouth for sand protection, but in this character sheet stance the wrap is down to show the face).
HAIR_PROFILE_SIGNATURE: Long black hair gathered into a single braid down the back/side
BEARD_PROFILE_SIGNATURE: Long groomed black beard (longer and more cultivated than raider A's stubble)
SIG_EQUIP_FRONT_VISIBLE: Left forearm vambrace with mechanical sighting device prominently visible, dark metallic claw-cap fingertips on right hand visible
SIG_EQUIP_BACK_VISIBLE: Long composite recurve bow strapped diagonally across the back fully visible
ROLE_SENTENCE: A male desert raider, common-rank tribe member specializing in long-range archery and tracking for hunting parties. Most experienced of the tactical unit
BUILD_DESC: Lean tall slim build—long limbs, narrow shoulders relative to height, the body type of an experienced archer who values reach and precision over raw strength. NOT bulky muscular, NOT chunky, NOT slender frail, NOT teenage gangly.
BUILD_ANALOGY: a desert hunter who has tracked and killed at distance for fifteen years
HAIR_DESC: Long black hair gathered tightly back into a single thick braid running down the back/side, falling to mid-back length. Some hair pulled back smooth across the scalp before tying. Possibly a small leather cord or fragment of bone tied at the end of the braid.
BEARD_DESC: Long groomed black beard reaching to mid-chest, sometimes braided in a single segment at the chin. Cultivated and intentional grooming—not the chieftain's wild stubble or raider A's short stubble.
SCARS_DESC: A thin diagonal scar across the left cheekbone, deep crow's feet around both eyes from years of squinting at distant targets. Weathered skin with sun damage texture.
HEADWEAR_DESC: Tribal headwrap of weathered tan-and-rust desert cloth, currently pulled down loose around the neck/shoulders (face fully uncovered for character sheet purposes). The wrap is the type that can be pulled up to cover the lower face/nose for sandstorm/wind protection during operations.
UPPER_BODY_DESC: Weathered dark leather long-sleeved tunic with reinforced left forearm vambrace (the bow-arm side, protecting from bowstring slap and serving as armor).
SIG1_DESC: The left forearm vambrace incorporates a small bronze mechanical sighting device—a folding bronze frame with small lens and adjustable sight markers, designed to mount on the bow arm during draw. War-torn brass-and-leather construction with visible bolts, leather strapping, slight verdigris patina (Mecha Crimson Bronze #7A6845, Aged Gold #846035 accent). NOT a prosthetic limb replacement—the underlying arm is intact, this is wearable equipment armor with mechanism.
SIG2_DESC: Each fingertip on the right hand (the draw hand) is capped with a small dark bronze metal claw-cap—originally functional protection for the bowstring-drawing fingers, doubles as scratching/clawing close-combat tool when bow is unavailable. Subtle dark verdigris patina.
LOWER_BODY_DESC: Form-fitting weathered dark leather trousers tucked into knee-high desert boots wrapped with cloth bindings and reinforced inner-leg panels (rider/horseman wear). Multiple small belt pouches (extra arrow tips, bowstring spares, repair tools).
FOOTWEAR_DESC: Knee-high desert leather boots with cloth bindings, reinforced soles for steady archer's stance.
PRIMARY_WEAPON: Long composite recurve bow (full hunting size, horn and sinew construction, dark wood and bone color) strapped diagonally across the back. The signature weapon of his role.
SECONDARY_WEAPON: Large arrow quiver attached at right hip or across back, with 15-20 arrows, feathered ends visible
SIDEARM_WEAPON: Short combat knife at left waist belt for close-quarters
POSE_ARM_NOTE: Left arm slightly raised or at side showing the vambrace mechanism, right hand at side or near the knife showing the finger claw-caps
POSE_ANALOGY: The body language of an experienced hunter at rest.
CONSISTENCY_LIST: identical face structure (Central Asian/Turkic/Sogdian features), identical long braided hair, identical long groomed beard, identical clothing items, identical left vambrace with sighting mechanism, identical right finger claw-caps, identical sparse refined trophy decorations
TITLE_TEXT: SAND HUNTER COMMON RAIDER C · ARCHER — DEFAULT FORM CHARACTER SHEET
DETAIL_ENUM: leather strap, arrow feather, gear/lens on the vambrace sighting mechanism, finger claw-cap
NEG_BODY: NOT bulky muscular, NOT chunky, NOT slender frail, NOT teenage gangly, NOT young appearance (must be 33-37 weathered veteran with deep sun lines and patient archer demeanor). NOT clean-shaven or stubble (long groomed beard mandatory).
NEG_EQUIPMENT: NOT a prosthetic limb replacement (no mechanical limbs, only wearable vambrace and finger caps), NOT same equipment as raider A (no lasso winch, no back-mounted hook launcher, no large mechanical chest device), NOT same equipment as raider B (no goggles, no throwing-dart bandolier, no high ponytail), NOT chieftain-level brutalist trophy mass, NOT lieutenant-level refined woven decoration.
NEG_LAYOUT: NOT 1:1 square aspect (must be vertical 9:16), NOT equal-sized 4 panels (top row smaller, bottom row larger), NOT face visible in bottom-left panel (face strictly cropped out at top of panel), NOT face covered by headwrap in face close-up panels (wrap pulled down to neck, face fully visible), NOT colorful background (solid neutral light-warm-grey only), NOT soft even neutral lighting (must be single-side rim backlight only), NOT front light, NOT fill light, NOT any text other than the four panel labels and the title.
BACK_GEAR: large arrow quiver attached at hip with feathered arrow ends visible
PERSONAL_ITEMS: SPARSE BUT REFINED—a few carefully chosen small bone trophies, a polished arrow tip from a defeated enemy archer, one small carved bead. Less quantity than the lieutenant's refined woven beads but more cultivated/chosen than raider A's pure utilitarian sparseness.
